title: The Tue Alpha
description: A strange Minecraft alpha, no doubt...
body:
This modpack is for Minecraft Alpha. Check the history below.

Do not configure anything (except new mods or the running mechanic to enable/disable).

Here's a screenshot of it.

![...](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/LuBsru3b/images/171660dae4ea68101e20f047bb056f8d7e779576.png)

History:
You used to play pirated Minecraft as a kid, but strange things happened. When you grew up, you decided to buy Minecraft and play that version, but nothing happened. Then you figured it out. You dusted off your first PC, an HP Pavilion zd7000, found the program, transferred it via USB, and now here you are.

Commands are now allowed (and if you didn't know before, you weren't).

This modpack adds a couple of ARG horror mods like The Broken Script, Six Alpha Six, no_moon.jar, and three more.

In my opinion, it feels like being in a Minecraft liminal space—a normal, peaceful place, but not for long. You absolutely cannot have cheats enabled, no matter what you try. The modpack deals more with dimensions and a kind of survival in hell. It would be more advisable to play for 100 or 200 days and complete all the missions from the other mods. This modpack could potentially restart your PC, but it's configured not to. Instead, it can open the following: Notepad, CMD, PowerShell (a harmless text application), a browser, VLC (it no longer does this; I removed it), and it can rarely close Minecraft. It can also disable random keyboard keys (it doesn't include WASD, TER, RY, OP, MP, B, but it's very common for it to disable ESC).

If your PC is damaged, I'm not responsible (I shouldn't be, and if it is, well, I tried).

Future versions will include mods, including other, more annoying ones that destroy your base, house, world, and desktop.

The modpack includes some useful tools for everyday use:

1: An axe that fires missiles and deals 13 damage. It's crafted by defeating various bosses from (no_moon.jar).

2: An altar. It's crafted with an antivirus and protects an area of ​​100 to 300 blocks. It prevents the corruption of chunks, entities that appear in the area, and meteorites (from no_moon.jar).

3: Debug tools (only if you create a world in creative mode).


All the mods here were conceived as something behind the scenes in Minecraft, something never seen before, and updates are coming soon, so see you when version 1.0.0 is released.
